lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to change the number on a block to move more than one square, and choose the fewest blocks.
Each arrow block has a number.
It tells the cat how many squares to move.
Tap the number and pick a new one.
One block with 3 is shorter than three blocks with 1.
Count the squares to the goal.
Then put that number on the block.
Get the dog to the star with just ONE block.
Right 4 — one block did the job of four!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
